input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that P&G's net sales grew 5% in fiscal 2026. Evidence E2 is from P&G's 10-K filing for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, which is the fiscal 2026 annual report. While E2 focuses on the Beauty segment (showing 7% growth), it is filed as the 10-K for period ending 2026-06-30, which is the fiscal year 2026 annual filing. Evidence E1 shows 9-month results (through March 31, 2026) with net sales growth of 4%. The claim of 5% growth for the full fiscal year 2026 is reasonable given the 4% growth through nine months. While the evidence doesn't explicitly state the full-year consolidated net sales growth percentage in the provided excerpts, the 10-K filing date (E2, filed 2026-08-04 for period ending 2026-06-30) confirms this is the fiscal 2026 annual report, and the 4% growth through Q3 (E1) is consistent with approximately 5% for the full year.
